question: Within the frozen R7 interval from 64 to 128 independent observations per raw surface, at which of the fixed nested-prefix budgets 80, 96, and 112 does exact phase-anchored support first restore all nine three-alias entity classes?
hypothesis: R7's transition is a finite context-coverage threshold: class fragmentation and split entity triplets will be nonincreasing across 64, 80, 96, 112, and 128 observations per surface, and at least one preregistered interior budget will induce exactly nine correct three-member classes with zero split triplets and zero cross-entity collision pairs. Once restoration occurs, every larger frozen budget will remain restored.

prior_evidence.observation: With nested independent prefixes, 64 observations induced 16 classes, three intact triplets, and six split triplets; both 128 and 256 observations induced nine correct triplets with zero splits and zero cross-entity collisions. Every surface had complete sixteen-context support by 128.

scope_statement: This experiment changes exactly one dimension from R7: it observes three fixed interior nested-prefix budgets between the qualified 64-failure and 128-restoration endpoints. Data generation, representation, seeds, entity and family cardinalities, controls, and evaluator remain unchanged. It estimates only this deterministic seed panel's onset and does not claim a population sample-complexity law or language competence.
authority: research-only; no deployment, external-model inference, scheduler, queue, accepted-ref, production, broker, live-interface, or CKB-plane authority

arms_and_inputs.underlying_distribution: uniform over context_index 0..15 for every family and entity
arms_and_inputs.nested_prefix_rule: For each entity-family surface, every lower-budget record sequence must equal the same-length prefix of every higher-budget sequence.
arms_and_inputs.representation: R5 exact phase-anchored immediate-context support, selected over the same twenty-seven raw four-byte motifs as R7
arms_and_inputs.evaluation: class cardinality, same-entity alias integrity, support coverage, and evaluator-only cross-entity collision pairs

seeds.disjointness: Each entity-family sampler seed is distinct; no matched-seed scientific arm is present; all budgets are nested prefixes of the same per-surface streams.

controls: The 64-observation arm must exactly reproduce R7's 16 classes, three correct triplets, six splits, and zero cross-entity collisions.
The 128-observation arm must exactly reproduce R7's nine classes, nine correct triplets, zero splits, and zero cross-entity collisions.
All five arms are nested prefixes generated independently per surface with the frozen R7 seeds and record construction.
Every arm uses the same selected motifs, exact phase-anchored support equality, class induction, and evaluator-only semantic identity.

No family label, semantic label, alias dictionary, tokenizer, external model, network access, task learner, capacity growth, approximate matching, oracle correction, adaptive budget, or early stopping enters the experiment.
validity_criteria: Exact parent and North Star identities match.
The local deterministic R7 probe reproduces both frozen endpoint controls before R8 scientific output is emitted.
All lower-budget streams exactly match prefixes of the 128-observation streams.
Every surface has exactly its frozen number of records; every context index and byte construction is in range.
All metrics are finite and full Go regression passes before the probe.
No tokenizer, task training, external model, network call, capacity growth, fuzzy matching, threshold change, adaptive budget selection, or evaluator leakage occurs.

classification_rules.interior_onset_supported: Validity and controls pass; at least one interior arm is fully restored, class and split counts are nonincreasing, restoration never reverses, and interior_first_restored_budget is the smallest restored member of [80,96,112].
classification_rules.endpoint_only_restoration: Validity and controls pass; none of 80, 96, or 112 is fully restored, while 128 is fully restored and all monotonicity conditions pass; interior_first_restored_budget equals 0.
classification_rules.budget_response_falsified: Validity and controls pass, but class count or split-triplet count increases with budget, or a fully restored arm is followed by a non-restored arm.
classification_rules.mixed: Validity and controls pass, but results satisfy none of the preceding scientific rules.
classification_rules.negative_control_failure: Either the 64 or 128 R7 endpoint replication fails any frozen exact threshold.
classification_rules.incomplete: Compute interruption prevents all five frozen arms.
classification_rules.invalid: Any identity, construction, nested-prefix, sampling, representation, leakage, evaluator-boundary, determinism, finite-metric, or qualification criterion fails.

stop_conditions: Stop invalid before science on parent, North Star, R7 endpoint replication, construction, build, or frozen-package drift.
After R8 output begins, complete all five arms and all frozen evaluations unless infrastructure prevents it.
Do not add budgets, inspect alternate seeds, or alter sampling, representation, controls, metrics, thresholds, budgets, capacity, or classification after observing R8 output.
no_post_result_tuning_rule: No budget, context distribution, sample sequence, seed, representation rule, class learner, control, metric, threshold, capacity, stop condition, or interpretation may change after primary R8 output.
